item.title: Start With the Box
item.description: But something within us rejects the idea of living within a box, of living within boundaries. Something tells us that it’s awful, it is terrible, it is restricting. We can almost feel the noose. We want no boundaries! The problem is, if we don’t live within God’s boundaries, we end up with a sloppy mess.
